answers.1:
sysctl kernel.ostype      # kernel.ostype = Linux
sysctl -n kernel.ostype > /tmp/ostype.txt
cat /tmp/ostype.txt     # Linux
answers.2:
echo /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward > /tmp/path.txt
cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward > /tmp/value.txt
cat /tmp/path.txt /tmp/value.txt
# sysctl -n net.ipv4.ip_forward 와 같은 값
answers.4:
cat > /etc/sysctl.d/90-lab.conf <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1
vm.swappiness = 10
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/90-lab.conf
# 실제 서버: sudo sysctl --system 으로 적용
answers.5:
cat /srv/lab/mod/lsmod.txt
awk 'NR>1 && $3==0 {print $1}' /srv/lab/mod/lsmod.txt > /tmp/unused.txt
cat /tmp/unused.txt   # br_netfilter, dummy, veth
answers.6:
grep '^parm:' /srv/lab/mod/modinfo-overlay.txt
grep '^parm:' /srv/lab/mod/modinfo-overlay.txt | awk '{split($2,a,":"); print a[1]}' > /tmp/parms.txt
cat /tmp/parms.txt
answers.10:
cat > /etc/modprobe.d/lab.conf <<'EOF'
options overlay index=0
blacklist pcspkr
EOF
cat /etc/modprobe.d/lab.conf
